vb_textbox.text: My advice is to test which gnome provides the best harvest. Lets say red gnome gave 7 mushrooms last time you picked it, keep going with red until the harvest goes to 3 or less, then switch to the green gnome when offered which gnome until they also provide 3 or less mushrooms. Same with the purple and brown gnomes, keep testing which gives the most mushrooms and don't be loyal to one gnome. Stay with one gnome while they are giving a lot until the harvest isn't big and then test the other gnome if their harvest yields more, but if they are both low, keep switching till you find the one that harvest is better.
